name: Time Picker
description: A segmented hour and minute field with 12- and 24-hour cycles.

anatomy.description: The labeled container with group semantics around the segments.
The clamped hour segment labeled Hour.
The clamped minute segment labeled Minutes.
The AM/PM switch shown with the 12-hour cycle.

dos: Match hourCycle to the audience's locale.
Bind a string value like 09:30 and let the segments clamp while typing.
Pair with DatePicker or use DateTimePicker when the user needs a full timestamp.
donts: Don't use it for durations; use NumberInput with a unit.
Don't use it for time zones; pair with TimezoneSelect.
Don't prefill the current time unless now is a sensible default.

examples.title: Segmented time
examples.description: Fields clamp as you type; the 12-hour cycle adds an AM/PM toggle.

examples.title: 12-hour clock
examples.description: hourCycle={12} swaps the hour range and adds an AM/PM toggle.

guidance.useWhen: The user enters a time of day.
guidance.avoidWhen: A date or a date range is needed; use DatePicker or DateRangePicker.
guidance.behavior: Hour and minute fields clamp while typing; the 12-hour cycle adds a period toggle.
guidance.responsive: The segmented group stays inline and fits compact forms.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the hour, minute, and period controls.
Edits a segment; values clamp as you type.
Toggles AM or PM on the period buttons.

notes: The segments sit in a group named by the field label; the hour and minute inputs are labeled Hour and Minutes.
The AM/PM toggle reports its state through aria-pressed.
The 24-hour cycle omits the period control entirely.

props.description: Initial time in "HH:mm" (24h) when uncontrolled. Defaults to "00:00".
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: 12 shows a 1–12 hour field with an AM/PM toggle; 24 shows a 0–23 hour field.
props.name: hourCycle

props.description: Accessible name for the time field group.
props.name: label

props.description: Called with the 24-hour "HH:mm" value after every valid edit.
props.name: onChange
